properties.description: Content store round-trip and failure modes: the same bytes yield the same hash and are stored once; get(hash) returns exactly what put() took; a blob whose bytes no longer match its hash is REFUSED on read rather than returned (content addressing is only worth having if it is checked); a missing blob fails loud naming the hash and what referenced it; an interrupted write leaves no partial file, proven by writing to a temp path and renaming. PLANNED — written before the build so the shape of the proof is settled first.
properties.name: Content store round-trip, and its failure modes
